jobs.title: Housing Navigator
jobs.description:
**BASIC ROLE**

The Housing Navigator provides direct assistance to individuals and families experiencing homelessness or at risk of homelessness in the Imperial Valley. Funded through the Homeless Housing, Assistance and Prevention (HHAP) Round 4 grant, this position connects clients to housing resources, temporary shelter, rental assistance, and supportive services. The Housing Navigator works collaboratively with community partners, landlords, and service providers to reduce barriers and support clients in achieving stable housing.

**REPRESENTATIVE DUTIES**

* Conduct outreach to individuals and families experiencing homelessness or housing instability
* Complete housing assessments and assist clients in developing individualized housing stability plans
* Connect clients to emergency shelter, transitional housing, and permanent housing opportunities
* Assist clients in completing applications for rental assistance, rapid rehousing, and other housing programs
* Serve as a liaison between clients and landlords to facilitate housing placement and retention
* Coordinate with internal case managers and external service providers to address barriers to housing (e.g., mental health, substance use, domestic violence, unemployment)
* Maintain accurate and timely case notes, documentation, and data entry in compliance with grant reporting requirements
* Assist clients in understanding tenant rights and responsibilities
* Participate in coordinated entry system (CES) activities and community collaborative meetings
* Support program compliance with HHAP R4 grant objectives and reporting deadlines
* Perform other duties as assigned
* Schedule may be flexible 8am\-5pm, 9am\-6pm \& 10am\- 7pm

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

* High school diploma or GED required, Associate's or bachelor’s degree in social work, Human Services, or related field preferred
* Minimum one (2\) year of experience in case management, housing services, or social services
* Knowledge of local housing resources, shelter systems, and community services in the Imperial Valley
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Valid California driver's license and reliable transportation required
* Ability to pass background check
* Experience working with homeless populations, domestic violence survivors, or vulnerable communities
* Familiarity with coordinated entry systems (CES) and HMIS data systems
* Knowledge of landlord engagement and housing retention strategies
* Experience in a nonprofit or social services environment

**SKILLS**

* Bilingual in Spanish ***preferred.***
* Strong comfort level with public speaking and representing the agency.
* Compassionate, trauma\-informed approach to service delivery
* Highly organized with strong follow\-through
* Ability to manage a caseload and prioritize multiple tasks
* Culturally competent and sensitive to the needs of diverse populations
* Self\-motivated and able to work both independently and as part of a team

**LICENSES AND CERTIFICATES**

* **Must be able to obtain background and drug test clearance.**
* Must possess a valid California driver’s license/minimum vehicle insurance required by law and maintained throughout the duration of employment. **Please note:** Upon job offering a current California driver's license and a driving record acceptable to the Agency's insurance carrier is required.
* No Driver can have any of the following in the last three years: 1\) More than 3 moving violations or 2 accidents, 2\) No suspensions of revocation of license, 3\) No single violaton involving reckless driving, driving under the influence, racing or fleeing an officer or accident.

Pay: $22\.00 \- $24\.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Housing Focused Case Manager
jobs.description:
**Hope Mission Statement**


The mission of Hope the Mission is to prevent, reduce and eliminate poverty, hunger, and homelessness by offering immediate assistance and long\-term solutions.

**Position Purpose and Summary**
Permanent housing is not simply a destination — it is the foundation from which recovery, stability, and forward momentum become possible. For participants living in interim housing, the path to that foundation requires skilled guidance, consistent support, and someone committed to making it happen. The Housing\-Focused Case Manager is that person.


Working under the supervision of the Program Manager, the Housing\-Focused Case Manager provides individualized, housing\-first case management to participants in Hope the Mission's interim housing programs. This role prioritizes rapid placement into permanent housing using low\-barrier, harm\-reduction, and trauma\-informed approaches — and is directly accountable for the documentation, engagement, and cross\-team collaboration that makes those placements possible. The goal is not just to find someone a home. It is to shorten their time in shelter, strengthen their readiness, and build the stability that allows them to stay housed once they get there.

**Primary Duties and Responsibilities***Housing\-Focused Case Management*

* Provide individualized, housing\-focused case management using Housing First, low\-barrier, and trauma\-informed approaches with a primary emphasis on rapid permanent housing placement.
* Conduct participant assessments to identify housing barriers, preferences, and eligibility for housing resources and subsidies
* Develop, implement, and regularly update Housing Action Plans with clear, measurable goals oriented toward permanent housing placement
* Maintain active, regular contact with participants focused on housing progress, problem\-solving, and motivation
* Support participants in understanding tenant rights, lease obligations, and expectations for successful tenancy

*Housing Navigation \& Placement*

* Assist participants with all housing navigation activities including applications, referrals, document collection and verification, housing interviews, unit viewings, lease signings, and move\-in logistics
* Communicate consistently with partnering housing navigation agencies to ensure participants are actively accessing housing services
* Coordinate move\-in assistance resources including deposits and other housing supports as available

*Documentation \& Compliance*

* Document all services, participant contacts, and housing activities accurately and on time in HMIS or agency\-approved data systems in compliance with contract obligations and internal standards
* Ensure all HMIS data is updated within 48 hours of participant contact or activity
* Track and report housing outcomes including referrals, placements, length of stay, and program exits
* Adhere to all agency policies, procedures, and safety protocols including incident reporting and grievance procedures

*Collaboration \& Coordination*

* Collaborate with Housing Navigators, Data Coordinators, Assistant Program Managers, Program Managers, and external housing partners to support participant housing progress
* Participate in case conferences, supervision, housing case reviews, chart reviews, and team meetings as required
* Coordinate with site staff, operations, and leadership to address housing\-related concerns that may impact participant stability while in interim housing

 *Other Duties*

* Conduct field\-based work as needed, including off\-site housing appointments, unit viewings, document collection, and landlord meetings
* Support specific populations — individuals, families, or Transitional Age Youth — based on program assignment
* Work flexible schedules including occasional evenings or weekends based on participant and housing availability needs
* Support interim housing staff with wellness checks, de\-escalation, and unit compliance as needed
* Perform other duties as assigned

**Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong housing\-focused problem\-solving, navigation, and participant engagement skills
* Ability to manage a caseload with competing priorities and deadlines
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong documentation and organizational skills with consistent attention to detail
* Ability to work collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams
* Professional boundary\-setting and sound ethical decision\-making
* Proficient in HMIS, Client Track, Microsoft Office Suite, and basic computer applications
* Strong understanding of contract compliance, program accountability, and outcomes measurement practices.
* Ability to lead with integrity and uphold organizational mission, values, and service philosophy.

 **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Social Work, Human Services, Psychology, or equivalent experience
* Minimum one (1\) year of experience in homeless services, housing navigation, or case management OR Minimum three (3\) years of experience working with individuals experiencing homelessness or similar populations
* Knowledge of Housing First, Harm Reduction, Trauma\-Informed Care,, and motivational interviewing practices
* Knowledge of HUD guidelines, subsidized housing programs, and Coordinated Entry System preferred
* Experience with HMIS or similar data systems is preferred

jobs.description:
**Qualifications \& Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in social work, psychology, human services, sociology, or a related field preferred. Relevant professional and lived experience may be considered in place of a degree.
* At least two years of relevant experience in case management, youth services, housing navigation, homelessness services, foster\-youth services, or another related field preferred.
* Experience working with young adults affected by foster care, housing instability, trauma, poverty, or limited family support.
* Experience training, coordinating, supervising, or supporting volunteers preferred.
* Knowledge of housing searches, rental applications, budgeting, community resources, public benefits, and common barriers to housing.
* Ability to build supportive relationships while maintaining clear professional boundaries.
* Strong organization, communication, documentation, follow\-through, and problem\-solving skills.

* Ability to respond calmly and appropriately to conflict, crises, and sensitive situations.
* Ability to work collaboratively with participants, volunteers, hosts, staff members, and community partners.
* Personal qualities of integrity, credibility, reliability, creativity, and accountability.
* Genuine commitment to Finally Family Homes’ mission and the young adults we serve.
* Reliable transportation and the ability to travel locally for meetings or participant support, as needed.

* Work closely with the Host Homes Program Manager to support the effective operation of the Host Homes Program.
* Conduct intake interviews, assessments, and program orientations with prospective participants.
* Help facilitate interviews between prospective hosts and participants to support thoughtful, appropriate, and ethical matches.
* Develop short\-term service plans that address participants’ immediate needs.
* Work with participants to create individualized success plans addressing medium\- and long\-term goals.

* Coordinate services with outside agencies and providers to support participants’ needs and reduce duplication of services.
* Maintain regular contact with participants and monitor progress toward identified goals.
* Support the resolution of concerns or conflicts involving participants and hosts.
* Provide crisis support as appropriate and follow organizational safety, reporting, and escalation procedures.
* Keep the Host Homes Program Manager informed of significant participant, host, or program developments, including safety concerns, conflicts, grievances, or accountability issues.
* Support participants as they prepare to transition from Host Homes into stable housing.

* Monitor participant and coach communication, assigned activities, housing\-search progress, and program participation.
* Provide professional case\-management support when participant needs or concerns exceed the volunteer coach’s role.
* Coordinate approved housing\-related assistance, referrals, and limited follow\-up after placement.
* Maintain accurate program records and track participant services, volunteer activity, housing applications, placements, and outcomes.
* Gather feedback, address program concerns, and recommend improvements to strengthen service delivery.

**Volunteer and Program Coordination**

* Coordinate with the Volunteer Coordinator on the recruitment, screening, onboarding, and retention of Housing Navigation Coaches.
* Participate in prospective coach interviews and help assess volunteers’ readiness for the role.
* Maintain appropriate boundaries between volunteer coaching and professional case management.
* Monitor coach performance and address incomplete work, communication concerns, or failure to follow program expectations.
* Assist with coach meetings, continuing education, and recognition activities.
* Help maintain current program handbooks, worksheets, training materials, procedures, and resource lists.

* Maintain timely, accurate, and complete participant files, assessments, service plans, case notes, referrals, and program records.
* Track participant enrollment, services, volunteer activity, housing applications, placements, and other required outcomes.
* Complete documentation needed for organizational, grant, and contract reporting.
* Protect participant confidentiality and follow all organizational policies, procedures, professional boundaries, and data\-security requirements.

jobs.title: Program Manager II
jobs.description:
Berkeley, California is a small city with a big reputation. At just ten square miles of land and seven square miles of water, Berkeley is famous around the globe as a center for academic achievement, scientific exploration, free speech, and the arts, and home to over 50 parks, a top\-ranked university, and the largest public marina in the San Francisco Bay.


**JOB OPPORTUNITY**
-------------------


The City of Berkeley invites applications for the Program Manager II position! As a Program Manager II, you will have the opportunity to organize and manage major City programs or projects that have a high degree of visibility and are of substantial impact. Responsibilities include development and implementation of program goals and elements. You may also supervise staff and develop procedures, programs and methodologies.
  

  

The current vacancy is in the Health, Housing, and Community Services (HHCS) Department. However, the eligible list established from this recruitment may be used to fill vacancies in several departments throughout the City.
  

  

In the HHCS Department: The incumbent will lead the strategic planning, operations, and management of at least two units within Berkeley's Housing and Community Services Division. This role involves overseeing affordable housing initiatives, supportive services, and division\-wide special projects aimed at supporting low\-income, homeless, senior, and disabled community members. Operating with minimal supervision, the manager will supervise professional staff and ensure compliance with various federal, state, and local funding sources.
  

  

See the full job specification here: https://www.governmentjobs.com/careers/berkeley/classspecs/1422589


**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**
--------------------------


A typical way of gaining the knowledge, skills, and abilities for this classification is:
  

Equivalent to graduation from a four year college or university with major coursework in business or public administration, or a related field and five (5\) years in the development and implementation of programs.
  

  

Other requirements: Must be able to travel to various locations within and outside the City of Berkeley to meet program needs and to fulfill the job responsibilities. When driving on City business, the incumbent is required to maintain a valid California driver's license as well as a satisfactory driving record. Must be able to attend evening and weekend meetings.


**APPLICATION PROCESS**
-----------------------


Applications must be received by 5:00 PM Pacific on September 28, 2026 and must include a completed application and answers to the supplemental questions. Please note that resumes are not a substitute for a completed application.  

  

Applications are available in alternative formats (audio\-format, braille, large print, electronic text, etc.) upon request to ada@berkeleyca.gov. Please allow 10 days for production of the material in an alternative format.
**EXAM PROCESS**
----------------


The exam process will include, but may not be limited to:
* Application review for minimum qualifications and required documents
* Review of Supplemental Questionnaire
* Oral Board Exam
  

Tests may consist of any combination of written, oral or other exercises or assessment procedures that test content and may include, but are not necessarily limited to, typing, math, reading, writing and analytical skills; problem solving ability; computer and software proficiency, or any other job\-related knowledge, skill, ability or qualification. The examination process and dates are subject to change. The City may, without notice, change or eliminate any assessment component as needs dictate. Applicants passing all examination phases will have their names placed on an employment eligible list that hiring departments will use to conduct final selection interviews.  

  

  

Reasonable Accommodations: The City is committed to making reasonable accommodations in the examination process and in the work environment. Individuals requesting reasonable accommodations in the examination process must submit a request in writing to hr@berkeleyca.gov at the time of application.
**PRE\-EMPLOYMENT PROCESS**


Candidates under final consideration for employment with the City will undergo an employment background check that may include, but is not limited to: confirmation of employment history, educational credentials and degrees, certificates, registrations, and licenses including driver's license; credit check; criminal history check; and Live Scan fingerprinting.


**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY (EEO) EMPLOYER**


The City of Berkeley is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer. All employment actions shall be administered regardless of race, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, age, physical or mental disability or medical condition, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, marital status, pregnancy, political affiliation, veterans’ status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.


**DISASTER SERVICE WORKER**


All City employees are required to provide services as Disaster Service Workers in the event of an emergency/disaster.

jobs.title: Client Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**


The Client Care Coordinator plays a vital role in guiding clients and their families through the home care process while ensuring Safe Harbor Home Care caregivers are trained, supported, and consistently delivering exceptional service. This position serves as the bridge between clients, families, caregivers, healthcare partners, and internal teams to promote continuity of care, client satisfaction, caregiver success, and operational excellence.


The Client Care Coordinator demonstrates ownership and accountability in five core areas: Assessments and Client Support; Hospital/SNF Follow\-Up and Care Coordination; Quality Assurance and Reassessments; Client and Family Communication; and Caregiver Follow\-Up and Regional Support.

**1\. Assessments and Client Support**

* Conduct consultations with prospective clients and families to assess care needs and explain available home care services.
* Develop individualized, high\-quality care plans tailored to each client's physical, emotional, and personal care needs.
* Present care plans to clients and family members and address questions or concerns regarding services.
* Facilitate completion and signing of service agreements and required admission documentation.
* Collaborate with the Scheduling Team to ensure timely staffing and seamless initiation of care services.
* Serve as a resource during onboarding of new clients.
* Provide field support as needed to ensure continuity of care and client satisfaction.
* Assist with staffing coverage by filling gaps in care when necessary.
* Deliver direct client care when operational needs require.

**2\. Hospital / Skilled Nursing Facility Follow\-Up and Care Coordination**

* Maintain communication with hospitalized clients, family members, hospital staff, SNFs, social workers, and case managers.
* Coordinate home care services and care transitions for clients discharging from hospitals, rehabilitation centers, and SNFs.
* Collaborate with physicians, discharge planners, and healthcare providers.
* Support efforts to reduce avoidable hospital readmissions.
* Monitor client status during care transitions and communicate updates.

**3\. Quality Assurance, Reassessments, and Assignment of Benefits**

* Conduct routine quality assurance calls and in\-person visits.
* Perform scheduled care plan reassessments and update documentation.
* Ensure caregiver services align with established care plans, company standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Identify opportunities for service improvement.
* Obtain and maintain required Assignment of Benefits documentation.
* Ensure annual renewal and completion of AOBs for VA clients.

**4\. Client and Family Communication**

* Maintain regular communication with clients and family members.
* Address client and family concerns promptly, professionally, and compassionately.
* Serve as the primary liaison between clients, families, caregivers, and scheduling staff.
* Provide updates regarding staffing, care plan adjustments, and service changes.
* Encourage satisfied clients and families to provide reviews and testimonials.

**5\. Caregiver Follow\-Up and Regional Support**

* Conduct caregiver training, coaching, and field observations.
* Monitor caregiver performance and provide feedback.
* Support newly hired caregivers through regular follow\-up and mentoring.
* Ensure caregivers understand client\-specific care plans and expectations before assignments.
* Identify educational opportunities and provide additional training.
* Work closely with caregivers who have limited schedules or reduced hours.
* Assist with caregiver\-client matching and improve staffing consistency.

**Qualifications**


Education and Credentials

* High School Diploma or GED.
* Active Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA), Certified Home Health Aide (CHHA), or Home Care Aide (HCA) registration/certification.
* Valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and proof of automobile insurance.


Experience

* Minimum one year of caregiving experience in home care, home health, assisted living, memory care, skilled nursing, or related healthcare setting.
* Experience conducting client assessments and developing non\-medical care plans preferred.
* Experience working with hospitals, skilled nursing facilities, discharge planners, social workers, or case managers preferred.
* Experience training, mentoring, or supporting caregivers preferred.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-building skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication abilities.
* Exceptional customer service and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Working knowledge of ADLs, dementia care, companionship services, and home safety practices.
* Ability to train, mentor, and coach caregivers.
* Proficiency with electronic documentation systems and Microsoft Office applications.
* Competency in using Hoyer Lift and Sit\-to\-stand devices.


Physical Requirements


Ability to sit, stand, walk, bend, stoop, kneel, and reach throughout the workday. Ability to lift up to 25 pounds and travel throughout assigned service areas.


Working Conditions


Combination of office, client home, hospital, skilled nursing facility, and community\-based settings. Frequent local travel required.


The employer for this position is stated in the job posting. The Pennant Group, Inc. is a holding company of independent operating subsidiaries that provide healthcare services through home health and hospice agencies and senior living communities located throughout the US. Each of these businesses is operated by a separate, independent operating subsidiary that has its own management, employees and assets. More information about The Pennant Group, Inc. is available at http://www.pennantgroup.com.

* Facilitate completion and signing of service agreements and required admission documentation.
* Collaborate with the Scheduling Team to ensure timely staffing and seamless initiation of care services.
* Serve as a resource during onboarding of new clients.
* Provide field support as needed to ensure continuity of care and client satisfaction.
* Assist with staffing coverage by filling gaps in care when necessary.
* Deliver direct client care when operational needs require.

**2\. Hospital / Skilled Nursing Facility Follow\-Up and Care Coordination**

* Maintain communication with hospitalized clients, family members, hospital staff, SNFs, social workers, and case managers.
* Coordinate home care services and care transitions for clients discharging from hospitals, rehabilitation centers, and SNFs.
* Collaborate with physicians, discharge planners, and healthcare providers.
* Support efforts to reduce avoidable hospital readmissions.
* Monitor client status during care transitions and communicate updates.

**3\. Quality Assurance, Reassessments, and Assignment of Benefits**

* Conduct routine quality assurance calls and in\-person visits.
* Perform scheduled care plan reassessments and update documentation.
* Ensure caregiver services align with established care plans, company standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Identify opportunities for service improvement.
* Obtain and maintain required Assignment of Benefits documentation.
* Ensure annual renewal and completion of AOBs for VA clients.

**4\. Client and Family Communication**

* Maintain regular communication with clients and family members.
* Address client and family concerns promptly, professionally, and compassionately.
* Serve as the primary liaison between clients, families, caregivers, and scheduling staff.
* Provide updates regarding staffing, care plan adjustments, and service changes.
* Encourage satisfied clients and families to provide reviews and testimonials.

**5\. Caregiver Follow\-Up and Regional Support**

* Conduct caregiver training, coaching, and field observations.
* Monitor caregiver performance and provide feedback.
* Support newly hired caregivers through regular follow\-up and mentoring.
* Ensure caregivers understand client\-specific care plans and expectations before assignments.
* Identify educational opportunities and provide additional training.
* Work closely with caregivers who have limited schedules or reduced hours.
* Assist with caregiver\-client matching and improve staffing consistency.

**Qualifications**


Education and Credentials

* High School Diploma or GED.
* Active Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA), Certified Home Health Aide (CHHA), or Home Care Aide (HCA) registration/certification.
* Valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and proof of automobile insurance.


Experience

* Minimum one year of caregiving experience in home care, home health, assisted living, memory care, skilled nursing, or related healthcare setting.
* Experience conducting client assessments and developing non\-medical care plans preferred.
* Experience working with hospitals, skilled nursing facilities, discharge planners, social workers, or case managers preferred.
* Experience training, mentoring, or supporting caregivers preferred.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-building skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication abilities.
* Exceptional customer service and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Working knowledge of ADLs, dementia care, companionship services, and home safety practices.
* Ability to train, mentor, and coach caregivers.
* Proficiency with electronic documentation systems and Microsoft Office applications.
* Competency in using Hoyer Lift and Sit\-to\-stand devices.


Physical Requirements


Ability to sit, stand, walk, bend, stoop, kneel, and reach throughout the workday. Ability to lift up to 25 pounds and travel throughout assigned service areas.


Working Conditions


Combination of office, client home, hospital, skilled nursing facility, and community\-based settings. Frequent local travel required.


The employer for this position is stated in the job posting. The Pennant Group, Inc. is a holding company of independent operating subsidiaries that provide healthcare services through home health and hospice agencies and senior living communities located throughout the US. Each of these businesses is operated by a separate, independent operating subsidiary that has its own management, employees and assets. More information about The Pennant Group, Inc. is available at http://www.pennantgroup.com.

Employees serve as a specialist, liaison and advocate for the program, with regular contact with County management and peers, other government, private sector or community\-based organizations, and members of the public. This classification is distinguished from the Senior Program Manager by a combination of factors which may include, but are not limited to, the latter classification’s responsibilities for managing multiple complex programs with greater breadth, depth, and span of control; a greater preponderance of budgetary and administrative accountabilities; or more complex service delivery provisions, including oversight of licensed professional staff.

**VOALA**


***Helping Our Most Vulnerable Change Their Life Stories***


Volunteers of America is a non\-profit human services organization committed to serving people in need, strengthening families, and building communities. VOA \- LA provides a variety of social services to Los Angeles area communities such as Head Start programs, Upward Bound college prep programs, veterans’ services, homeless shelters, low\-income housing program as well as drug and alcohol rehabilitation. Learn more at www.voala.org.


**PAY RATE:** $26\.68 \- $28\.08 Per Hour


**BENEFITS:** VOALA offers competitive medical, dental, vision and retirement benefits


**JOB SUMMARY AND PURPOSE**


The Senior Case Manager is the subject matter expert for the case management team. The Senior Case Manager will mentor the team, and, as directed by the Program Coordinator, will arrange, coordinate, monitor, and assure all delivered services by the case management team meet the needs of SSVF clients. This includes assisting case managers in: assessing and reassessing client/household needs, educating on program and community resource opportunities, developing relevant service plans, scheduling appointments, and providing necessary follow\-up to ensure service plans are progressing on schedule and needs are adequately being addressed. The position requires a combination of administrative/office duties and field/outreach work.

jobs.title: Patient Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Form Health** is a national telemedicine weight loss clinic specialized in helping patients with obesity lose weight and lead healthier lives. Obesity impacts more than 40% of the US adult population, but only about 1% of patients receive medical treatment for their disease. The field of Obesity Medicine is entering a period of rapid growth that will see treatment rates surge. Today, Form Health can harness this growth to drive patient impact nationwide. We do this by making research\-based treatment available to patients through the convenience of telehealth, including long\-term care from a specialized physician and dietitian and FDA\-approved medication when appropriate. We hold ourselves to the highest standards of clinical care, and to treating every individual with empathy and respect.



Founded in 2019, Form Health is a venture\-backed startup with an experienced clinical team. Form Health's mission is to empower patients and be the leader in obesity medicine using personalized, research\-based treatment delivered through modern technology. The Patient Care Coordinator role supports physicians, dietitians and patients and is critical to our company mission of outstanding clinical care.


**About the role:**



Form Health's Patient Care Coordinators (PCCs) provide comprehensive support for daily clinical operations, ensuring our patients have a smooth, caring, and well\-organized experience from their very first interaction. Working collaboratively with medical clinicians and registered dietitians, PCCs support processes that enable excellent patient care. This includes a wide range of tasks from managing the patient's care team experience, coordinating patient scheduling, and assisting with benefits coordination, to answering questions regarding prescription fulfillment, and coordinating with external providers. PCCs will also provide essential support to clinicians by managing pre\-visit lab work and inputting vital sign and medical record documentation. We are passionate about helping people improve their health through weight loss and will provide you opportunities for learning and professional growth. This role is 100% remote.


**Where You'll Deliver Impact:**



We seek an experienced Medical Assistant, a collaborative team player with exceptional interpersonal and organizational skills, who is passionate about being part of a healthcare team and excited to work in a non\-traditional telemedicine practice environment. Ultimately, your role is about being organized, thoughtful, and empathetic, making sure every patient feels personally supported at every step of their journey.


**Key responsibilities include:**


**Care Team Management:**


* Acting as the primary point of contact to maintain communication flow between patients and their care team.
* Receiving, triaging, and resolving incoming clinical messages from patients to clinicians, and relaying messages from clinicians to patients as requested.
* Conducting regular outgoing patient communications to ensure consistent engagement and optimize their success in the program.
* Providing routine administrative support for clinicians
* Contributing to special projects as directed, helping to improve our systems and make care more efficient and effective.


**Lab / Medical Records Support:**


* Helping collect medical records from primary care or other providers when needed.
* Requesting medical records.
* Reviewing patient uploaded medical records.
* Facilitating Medical Records \& Prescriptions, including sending lab requisitions.
* Assisting with prior authorization coordination and other prescription\-related tasks.
* Assisting with medication refills and pharmacy questions.
* Supporting medical clinicians with pre\-visit lab orders.


**Membership / Program Status:**


* Guiding new patients through what to expect, both at the start and throughout their weight loss journey.
* Addressing general questions about the program.
* Supporting patients with account changes or cancellation requests.
* Providing feedback and communicating patient feedback to other company teams (i.e. Product, Engineering, Marketing) to improve operational tools and patient care.
* Assisting with clinical data collection as needed to track company's key clinical performance indicators or for quality improvement purposes.
* Providing scheduling and appointment support for patients.


**Billing / Insurance:**


* Assisting with general insurance and billing questions.
* Providing information regarding insurance coverage updates.
* Addressing billing concerns and coordinating with the billing department.
* Answering membership change questions related to billing.
* Providing information on the cost of memberships.
* Answering eligibility questions.


**You'll Be Successful in This Role Because You Have:**


* A Medical Assistant (MA) Certificate is required: **Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) from the American Association of Medical Assistants (AAMA)** *or* **Registered Medical Assistant (RMA) from the American Medical Technologists (AMT)** *or* **Certified Clinical Medical Assistant (CCMA) from the National Healthcareer Association (NHA).**
* At least two years of experience in a fast\-paced primary care, obesity medicine, or endocrinology practice.
* Experience with prescription prior authorization processes is a plus.
* Excellent customer service skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Highly organized with a proven ability to manage multiple tasks and time effectively.
* Proficient computer skills, with proficiency in platforms such as Slack and Google Workspace, and the ability to quickly adapt to evolving, custom\-built IT systems.


**More about FORM's benefits:**


* Competitive salary and equity in a high growth start\-up
* Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)
* 401k
* Flexible work schedules and paid time off
* Paid parental leave

**Become a part of our caring community**
=========================================

 **Shift/availability details:**

* **This is a part time position scheduled for 20 hours. Every other week the schedule will be as follows:**
* **Week 1 schedule: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday, Saturday from 6a\-10a EST.**
* **Week 2 schedule: Sunday, Monday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday from 6a\-10a EST.**

* **Required to work a rotating holiday schedule.**

* **Training requirements: Weekdays (Monday\-Friday) in the evenings and weekends (Saturday \& Sunday) during the day and/or in the evening.**


In this position you will work\-from\-home in a remote setting as a telephonic Registered Nurse.


As a **Care Manager, Telephonic Nurse**, you will report directly to the Manager, Care Management. You will help to ensure optimal continuity of care for patients transitioning into and out of our services. You will be responsible for being knowledgeable regarding post\-acute levels of care, and an expert regarding CenterWell Home Health services including home health, hospice, and palliative care. You will communicate with the CenterWell Home Health clinical team and help facilitate patient follow\-up for patients in need of (additional) services.

**Essential Functions:**

* Be a CenterWell Home Health representative in supporting patients who have been discharged from service or for those who may need post\-acute services. Navigate healthcare options; care services post\-acute offerings, Medicare coverage, billing issues, and accessing healthcare resources.
* Use a variety of tools and methods to quickly provide patient options and education including but not limited to sites of service, specialty offerings, post\-acute care, and other related questions. Handle a variety of customer issues including location lookup, directions, and complaints.
* Make clinical level of care determination based on discussion, medical records, and any other important clinical data. Match these needs to a service site location or, if not available, look up and provide alternative services. Be a customer advocate throughout the referral process to ensure timely response and to maximize referral to admission conversion rate. Follow\-up and track referral and admission outcomes.
* Maintain awareness and orientation to department performance objectives, meets standards, and assures patient satisfaction goals are met.
* Assist in the admissions process by acting as an ambassador for patients who meet the admissions requirements.
* Focus on placing the right patient to the right care setting at the right time.
* Adhere to and participates in Company's mandatory training which includes but is not limited to HIPAA privacy program/practices, Business Ethics and Compliance programs/practices, and Company policies and procedures.
* Review and adhere to all Company policies and procedures.
* Provide education regarding Home Health, Hospice, and Palliative Care Services.
* Help with clinical eligibility review for alternate services.
* Participate in special projects and perform other responsibilities as assigned.

**Use your skills to make an impact**
=====================================

**Requirements:**

* Associates Degree required. BSN preferred.
* We require a compact state RN license. Business needs may require additional state licensures be obtained.
* At least 3 years post\-acute nursing experience. Home health or hospice experience preferred.
* Knowledge of home health, hospice, and palliative care services.
* Learn and master information related to locations and services of clients.
* Analytical and can problem\-solve.
* Excellent verbal and interpersonal skills.
* Communication with empathy over the phone.
